roleNote: An example of what you can build from kit components. Start from it, change it, or ignore it; layout is your choice. Follow `must` (kit look and accessibility); `defaults` are this example's suggestions, change any of them.
copyNote: Not exported from agentic-ds-kit. add copies the source into your app (components/patterns/billing-schedule/) with this contract beside it. You own the copy: replace the demo data, rearrange or drop sections, and keep the `must` lines.
intent: Billing schedule for one customer: the next charge as one figure with its lines, a failure Alert that says what happens next, and Upcoming and Billed as two kit Tables with status as icon and word. Scheduled charges open a kit Drawer to move the date, change the amount or skip the month.
must: Use kit components from agentic-ds-kit for anything the kit has; no local cousins (tables, dialogs, rows, rules, charts)
Semantic tokens only (agentic-ds-kit/tokens.css); no raw hex, no primitive --color-* ramps
At most one appearance="solid" mode="primary" Button per view
Do not restyle kit components; change them through their props, slots, and tokens
Status is a word in a kit Badge with its icon (Scheduled, Retrying, Invoiced, Paid, Failed…), never colour alone
Upcoming and Billed are two kit Tables; do not build a local charges list
A failed payment is a kit Alert (danger) that names the invoice, the amount, the next and last retry, and what happens after
Edit is a kit Drawer on scheduled charges only (no pencil on retries or billed rows); Skip asks once in a kit AlertDialog
Money arrives pre-formatted from your app; label example data as example

Render inside a main landmark (wrap the pattern, or your page content, in <main>); header and nav chrome, if any, use AppHeader / SideNav (or other header / nav landmarks) and nav stays reachable on small screens
defaults: Section title "Billing schedule" with Ask (outline, MessageCircle) and Download all (ghost) in its actions
The first scheduled row says Next charge after its description, as a word in info text (not a second Badge); the next-charge Card is not shown beside the tables
With a failed payment the failure Alert spans the width above the tables; Update card in the Alert is the one solid primary

Tables show Date (01 Dec 2026), Description, Status (Upcoming, Retrying, Invoiced, Paid, Failed, Waived) and Amount at md size. Upcoming (next 60 days, oldest first) ends with a total row; Billed (last 60 days, newest first) has Download per invoice. Row actions are icon Buttons (Table rowActionsAs="icons") named with the charge and date

The edit Drawer is md on the right: Charge date (DatePicker), Amount (CurrencyInput), Apply to (RadioGroup, only for a split fee), Skip this month in footerStart, then Cancel and Save changes. After Save the row moves, focus returns to its pencil and a polite status says where it moved
nextOnly shows just the next-charge Card: Next charge on the date, the figure, the card and due line, its lines and the draft invoice, then Change card at the end of the row

summary is the overview card for a Billing page (the settings example uses it): no next-charge Card, the first `limit` charges (default 3) in two columns, charge with date and status, and amount, so it fits a half-width column, plus View all (ghost) via onViewAll
Loading is the Table loading state (header stays, Skeleton rows); empty uses a kit Empty (Calendar); a load error uses a danger Alert with Retry (outline)
snippet: <BillingSchedulePattern onAsk={ask} onDownloadAll={download} onDownloadInvoice={downloadInvoice} onUpdateCard={updateCard} onSaveCharge={saveCharge} onSkipCharge={skipCharge} />
